title: SLOW English Practice for B1 INTERMEDIATE - talking about 👉 AIRPORTS✈️

header.titleZh: B1 中級的慢速英語練習 - 談 👉 機場✈️
header.titleEn: SLOW English Practice for B1 INTERMEDIATE - talking about 👉 AIRPORTS✈️

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I'm excited to talk about airports I hate airports airports are the worst my experience with airports is probably very similar to everybody else's whenever.
sentences.tc: 今天我很高興談論機場 我討厭機場 機場是最糟糕的機場 我在機場的經歷可能與其他人的經歷非常相似。

sentences.en: I go to the airport I just pray I didn't forget one tiny tiny detail one tiny tiny deta tell that could make me miss my flight.
sentences.tc: 我去機場，我只是祈禱我沒有忘記任何一個微小的細節，一個微小的細節，這些細節可能會讓我錯過航班。

sentences.en: I triple check everything I triple check every single detail and when I'm done.
sentences.tc: 我對所有事情都進行了三次檢查，並在完成時對每個細節進行了三次檢查。

sentences.en: I check one more time I always make sure to check in online.
sentences.tc: 我再檢查一次，我總是確保在網上辦理登機手續。

sentences.en: I check in right away so that I have more peace of mind my peace of mind is very important for me at the airport.
sentences.tc: 我會立即辦理登機手續，以便更加安心，在機場安心對我來說非常重要。

sentences.en: I usually get my boarding pass on my phone.
sentences.tc: 我通常透過手機取得登機證。

sentences.en: I am ready to go I prefer to check in online than to check in in person I think it's less stressful checking in online.
sentences.tc: 我已準備好出發 我更喜歡在線辦理登機手續而不是親自辦理登機手續 我認為在線辦理登機手續壓力較小。

sentences.en: What do you prefer checking in online or in person convince me?
sentences.tc: 您喜歡在線檢查還是親自說服我？

sentences.en: Why why is it better the worst part of going to the area airport is the security check everyone is yelling and rushing and it's pure chaos it's too chaotic for me?
sentences.tc: 為什麼去該地區機場最糟糕的部分是安檢，每個人都大喊大叫，匆匆忙忙，這純粹是混亂，對我來說太混亂了？

sentences.en: Finding my gate is usually less stressful than going through security but it still is very frustrating to find my gate especially if the airport has like eight terminals but once.
sentences.tc: 找到我的登機口通常比通過安檢壓力要小，但找到我的登機口仍然非常令人沮喪，特別是如果機場有大約八個航站樓，但只有一個。

sentences.en: I am at my gate my worries go away now I just have to board my plane I only need to board and take a seat.
sentences.tc: 我在登機口，我的擔憂消失了，現在我只需登機，我只需登機並坐下。

sentences.en: I usually am the last person to board the plane Everyone is always so eager to board but I prefer to stay seated and wait.
sentences.tc: 我通常是最後一個登機的人 每個人總是那麼渴望登機，但我更喜歡坐在座位上等待。

sentences.en: Do you prefer to board the plane right away?
sentences.tc: 您喜歡立即登機嗎？

sentences.en: Do you prefer to take your time and wait?
sentences.tc: 您願意慢慢等待嗎？

sentences.tc: 我通常只帶一件個人物品（個人物品是一個小包）我不會裝很多東西。

sentences.en: I am a light packer I don't need a carryon and I don't need to check my luggage either.

sentences.en: I am a light traveler what luggage.

sentences.en: One thing I can say about airports is that anything goes you can see people people sleeping people eating McDonald's at 8 a.m. watching movies running stretching.
sentences.tc: 關於機場我能說的一件事是，無論發生什麼，你都可以看到人們在睡覺，人們在早上 8 點吃麥當勞，看電影跑步伸展。
